correctness.rationale: All pair orbits follow from two explicit invertible Shrikhande automorphisms and translations. The three representatives admit exact monitored-set and propagation checks, proving all 48 optimum pairs and no singleton. The unrestricted line graph follows by a Cayley isomorphism. Each vertex has two disjoint triangles of successful partners, giving a cubic 32-vertex intermediary whose line graph is the slide network. An explicit 32-node mapping checks all 48 edges of the Dyck LCF graph. Two standalone replayed verifiers confirm all 1,128 shortest-path comparisons and the rook contrast.

value.rationale: A natural canonical strongly regular graph has an exact optimal-sensor movement graph equal to the line graph of its classical cubic Dyck dual, revealing a new structural constraint for maintaining minimum monitoring. Locality changes sharp movement diameter from three to five. The rook companion has the same (16,6,2,2) parameters but a different minimum sensor budget, disproving a purely spectral budget determination. This is motivated structural geometry, not a known numerical table recast.
